en_US.title: Public Archive Review Queue Stamp
en_US.website_article:
A public archive review queue stamp tells the reader that an entry is visible but not settled. It can wait for source voice review, confidence ladder review, claimant-safe review, route alias review, or relation-edge review. The stamp keeps the page from looking broken and keeps the evidence from looking final.

The stamp is useful only when it names the safe next action. A plain waiting label is bureaucracy. A useful stamp tells the player what proof class is still pending without printing the hidden answer.
en_US.wiki_article: Review queue stamp: a visible page or relation state used when evidence is present but not settled. It should name visible review state, held reason class, source voice, and safe next action. It must not expose final relation or final outcome.
en_US.pda_codex: PDA review stamp: entry queued. Read the visible review state and safe next action. The hidden reason class is held until proof order clears it.
en_US.scanner_entry: Scanner queue tag: evidence visible, review pending. Safe action available.
en_US.terminal_note: Terminal review note: this entry is queued by proof class. Do not treat queue state as final approval.
en_US.evidence_caption: Review queue stamp: visible entry, pending proof class.
en_US.spoiler_policy: Safe to show visible review state and safe next action. Hold exact relation, final receiver, protected claimant, Atlas consequence, legal verdict, and rescue conclusion behind later proof gates.

en_US.title: Wiki Page Template Hold Notice
en_US.website_article:
A wiki page template hold notice is a visible guardrail. It says that a section exists but is not safe to print yet. The section may be waiting for source voice, confidence state, relation edge, claimant-safe audit, route alias comparison, or proof escalation clearance.

The notice keeps the page shape honest. It avoids fake completeness and avoids spoiler leakage. A good hold names the safe requirement and leaves the answer protected.
en_US.wiki_article: Template hold notice: a page-template state for held sections. It should name section type, held proof class, safe preview label, and unlock hint. It must not reveal hidden relation, protected claimant, final route, or final consequence.
en_US.pda_codex: PDA section hold: section exists but is held. Check the safe requirement before opening it.
en_US.scanner_entry: Scanner page-state tag: page section held by proof class.
en_US.terminal_note: Terminal template note: held section is intentional. Complete safe proof action before revealing it.
en_US.evidence_caption: Template hold: section visible, answer protected.
en_US.spoiler_policy: Safe to show section type, held proof class, safe preview label, and unlock hint. Hold exact hidden relation, final receiver, protected claimant, Atlas consequence, legal verdict, and rescue conclusion behind later proof gates.

en_US.title: PDA Evidence Link Audit Trail
en_US.website_article:
A PDA evidence link audit trail records when a relation link changes state. A link can become visible, partial, locked, downgraded, or suppressed. The trail names the visible cause: source voice match, confidence change, receipt-body support, route alias conflict, claimant-safe hold, or proof escalation.

The audit trail is not a confession log. It does not print the exact hidden relation. It tells the player that proof order changed the graph and gives one safe next action.
en_US.wiki_article: Evidence link audit trail: a record of relation-link state changes. It should name previous state, new state, visible cause, held relation class, and safe next action. It must not reveal exact hidden relation or final outcome.
en_US.pda_codex: PDA link audit: evidence link changed state. Read previous state, new state, visible cause, and safe next action. The exact hidden relation remains protected.
en_US.scanner_entry: Scanner link audit tag: relation link state changed. Visible cause available; exact relation held.
en_US.terminal_note: Terminal audit note: link state changed by proof order. Do not infer final relation from the state change alone.
en_US.evidence_caption: Link audit trail: relation state changed, hidden relation protected.
en_US.spoiler_policy: Safe to show previous state, new state, visible cause, and safe next action. Hold exact hidden relation, final receiver, protected claimant, Atlas consequence, legal verdict, and rescue conclusion behind later proof gates.
